name: OSCLeash
author: yakuda and Runs ZenithVal's
description: Integrates ZenithVal's original OSCLeash directly into the chatbox for Windows and Linux—out of the box, with multi-leash process management, port collision warnings, and chatbox placeholders for leash state and direction.
summary: OSCLeash included - start, stop and debug any number of leashes, plus placeholders for the chatbox.

placeholders.state: pulled, or ready when nothing is being pulled
placeholders.compass: the same direction as N / NE / E …
placeholders.name: name of the leash being pulled
placeholders.count: how many OSCLeash instances are running

settings.label: 🎛 Control panel in its own window
settings.hint: Only needed on an app version that cannot show the panel inside this card. Where it can, the panel is already above and this stays off.

settings.label: OSCLeash override
settings.hint: Empty = the OSCLeash bundled with this plugin, which is what almost everyone wants. Only fill this in to run your own build instead: a checkout's OSCLeash.py, an AppImage or the OSCLeash.exe from the releases page.
filters: OSCLeash (OSCLeash OSCLeash.py OSCLeash*.AppImage OSCLeash*.appimage OSCLeash.exe OSCLeash-*)

settings.label: Start leashes with the app
settings.hint: Starts every instance that has 'Start with the app' ticked in the panel. Instances without that tick stay manual.

settings.label: Stop everything when the plugin stops
settings.hint: Off leaves the processes running after the chatbox closes - useful while testing, risky otherwise: the next start would spawn a duplicate on the same port.

settings.label: Restart a crashed instance
settings.hint: Brings an instance back a few seconds after it exited on its own. A Stop you pressed yourself is never overruled.

settings.label: Show a line while idle
settings.hint: Off means the chatbox only says something while a leash is actually being pulled.

settings.label: Idle text
settings.hint: Shown while at least one instance runs and nothing is pulled.

settings.label: Icon
settings.hint: Sits in front of the line. The button next to it opens the app's icon picker; empty for no icon.

settings.label: Hold the pull for
settings.hint: How long a pull keeps showing after the last movement. Too short and the line flickers while walking, too long and it lies.
